sets.relationshipLabel: a category of story or character and one named example of it
sets.explanation: Each pair pairs a broad story type with a single famous character who embodies it.

sets.relationshipLabel: a written or drawn plan and the made thing it specifies
sets.explanation: A blueprint and a recipe are both instructions that, when followed, produce the exact object named.

sets.relationshipLabel: the thing that lets another thing happen safely or comfortably
sets.explanation: Training wheels and a nightlight don't perform the activity themselves—they simply make it safe or comfortable to happen.

sets.relationshipLabel: an early stage within the larger span it opens
sets.explanation: Infancy and kindergarten are each the opening stage of a longer span—childhood and school—not just the step before it.
